_about: Pest/predator classes and decision thresholds. Values marked PLACEHOLDER must be confirmed with the ICAR-IIHR mentor before field use. Loaded by backend/src/services/pestConfig.js at startup.

decision._action_threshold_per_day: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with IIHR mentor. Average pests per trap per day (over the rolling window) that triggers action.
decision._spray_ratio: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with IIHR mentor. Pests per predator at or above which predators are NOT keeping pace -> SPRAY; below it -> RELEASE BIOCONTROL.
decision._rolling_window_days: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with IIHR mentor. How many of the most recent days with counts are averaged.
decision._count_uncertainty: PLACEHOLDER - to confirm with the trained model's evaluation. Relative +/- uncertainty of a count when detection confidence is unknown; with confidence c it is (1 - c), clamped to [min, max] below.
decision._check_trap_after_hours: PLACEHOLDER. A trap with no capture for this long shows CHECK TRAP (device offline or card not photographed).

image_quality._about: PLACEHOLDER thresholds - tune on real trap photos. Measured on the photo resized to 1024 px wide. A photo failing any check is not counted and the trap shows CHECK TRAP.
image_quality._min_sharpness: Variance of the Laplacian (grayscale), normalised to mid-grey exposure. Synthetic cards: sharp ~90, slightly soft ~40, blurry <5. Below this the photo is too blurry to count small insects.
image_quality._min_brightness: Mean luminance 0-255. Below this the photo is too dark.
image_quality._max_brightness: Mean luminance 0-255. A well-lit yellow card is about 190-215; above this it is overexposed.
image_quality._max_glare_fraction: Share of near-white pixels (all channels >= glare_level). Whiteflies are a small share; larger white patches are reflections.

spray_window._about: PLACEHOLDER spray-condition rules - to confirm with the IIHR mentor and the product label. Checked hour by hour on the Open-Meteo forecast.
spray_window._max_rain_probability: Percent. Rain this likely within the look-ahead washes the spray off.
spray_window._max_wind_kmh: Above this, spray drifts off target.
spray_window._min_wind_kmh: Below this in the evening/night, an inversion can hold fine droplets in the air (caution only).
spray_window._max_temp_c: Above this, droplets evaporate fast and plants are stressed (caution only).
spray_window._min_window_hours: A good window must last this many hours in a row.

degree_days._about: PLACEHOLDER whitefly development model - to confirm with the IIHR mentor. Daily degree-days = max(0, min(mean, upper) - base) using the daily max/min temperature.
degree_days._generation_degree_days: Approximate degree-days for one whitefly generation (egg to adult) above the base temperature.

impact._about: ESTIMATE ONLY - placeholder assumptions to confirm with the IIHR mentor and local farmers. Compares the traps' decisions with routine calendar spraying.
impact._calendar_spray_interval_days: Baseline: a typical farmer sprays every 7 days whatever the pest level.
impact._spray_reapply_days: While a trap stays at SPRAY, one spray covers this many days.
impact._release_interval_days: While a trap stays at RELEASE BIOCONTROL, one release covers this many days.
impact._product_litres_per_acre_per_spray: Pesticide product (not water) per acre per spray.
impact._cost_inr_per_acre_per_spray: Product + labour + equipment per acre per spray, in rupees.

economics._about: ESTIMATE ONLY - placeholder farm economics to confirm with the IIHR mentor and local farmers. Every value can be overridden per trap from the dashboard.
economics._crops: Marketable yield per acre per season and the farm-gate price.
economics._spray_cost_inr_per_acre: Pesticide product + labour + equipment for one spray of one acre.
economics._biocontrol_cost_inr_per_acre: One release of natural enemies (e.g. Encarsia / Macrolophus) for one acre.
economics._predator_value_inr_per_acre: What it would cost to rebuild a working predator population a spray would kill (re-release + lost control). Counted only when predators are on the card.
economics._weekly_loss_pct_at_threshold: Crop value lost per week if pests stay at the action level and nothing is done; scales with pests/day ÷ action level.
economics._horizon_days: The window the projection covers (until the next check).
